svg.title: Which clients honor which keys
svg.desc: A matrix of eight managed-settings keys against Copilot CLI, VS Code, the Copilot app, cloud sandbox and Actions sessions, and JetBrains IDEs, highlighting unsupported combinations.
svg.text: Sample of keys only. Several keys also need a minimum client version.
disableBypassPermissionsMode is under permissions. Recheck the reference before acting.
Rows: keys; columns: clients and session types
Green cell: gap to plan for, not a safety rating
